messages:
emily_pm: Acme asked for an EU "hedged" rollout: low-latency model behind a flag but with an automated cost-hedge that can shift a portion to cheaper variants if util or cost spikes. Need a plan that covers shadowing, canary slabs, A/B cost checks, and rollback/fallback.

raj_ops: Capacity notes: eu-west is bumped the next two weeks. We can reserve a 4-GPU canary pool for 72h, but must have a fallback routing to our quantized pool. Also request an ops-level kill switch accessible in Console and via API.

sid_eng: Implementation sketch: (1) preflight shadow 10h to warm caches and capture baseline diffs; (2) deploy routing layer that supports dynamic hedging policy; (3) canary slabs: 3%->15%->50%->100% with progressive gating. Each slab runs automated A/B and mirror checks.

claire_ml: Quality gates: automated eval on mirrored outputs every hour during canary. Targets: semantic-stability score >= 0.94, hallucination_delta < 0.9%, and user-intent-match >= 96%. We'll provide a 160-prompt eval set that covers long-context, system prompt drift, and E2E conversation snippets.

mario_sre: Reliability gates: p95_latency <= baseline + 35ms (if exceeded for 20m, promote rollback check), unhandled_error_rate <= baseline * 2. Circuit breaker: 3x error rate or sustained p95 > baseline + 120ms for 10m -> auto-flip kill. Also, if GPU util > 84% trigger hedging to shift 30% of new canary to quantized variant. Page #eng-oncall.

sid_eng: For cost-hedge A/B: split 20% of canary traffic to a quantized variant (mirrored responses) and compute cost_per_1k and quality divergence every 6h. Hedge rules: if cost_savings > 12% and quality_divergence < 1.5%, promote hedged routing for that tenant slice. All policy decisions must be logged and reversible.

emily_pm: Draft flag config (ops/devex review):
```yaml
flag: acme_eu_hedged_lowlatency_v2
enabled_for: ["acme_corp"]
region_filter: "eu"
preflight:
  mirror_hours: 10
canary_slabs:
  - pct: 3
    min_time: 8h
  - pct: 15
    min_time: 24h
  - pct: 50
    min_time: 48h
  - pct: 100
    min_time: 7d
hedging_policy:
  monitor: ["gpu_util","cost_per_1k","latency_p95","error_rate"]
  auto_shift_trigger:
    - when: "gpu_util >= 84%"
      action: "shift_pct: 30, target: quantized-q4"
    - when: "cost_per_1k > baseline * 1.15"
      action: "start_cost_ab_test pct:20"
cost_ab_test:
  pct: 20
  variant: quantized-q4
  eval_window: 24h
  stop_conditions:
    - quality_divergence_pct: 1.5
    - min_cost_savings_pct: 12
fallbacks:
  - when: "error_rate > baseline * 3 or p95_latency > baseline + 120ms"
    action: rollback
  - when: "sustained_gpu_util > 90%"
    action: route_to_cpu_fallback
emergency_controls:
  kill_switch: true
  ops_override: true
reporting: ["latency_p50","latency_p95","error_rate","quality_divergence","cost_per_1k"]
```

raj_ops: Please add: preflight must execute long-context warmups and prefix-cache priming for at least 4h during the mirror window. Reserve canary pool 24h before start. Add an explicit ops_ticket id when scheduling.

mario_sre: Alerts: page #eng-oncall and #product-alerts on circuit-breaker. Runbook brief: 1) flip kill_switch, 2) set hedging_policy to immediate 100% quantized for affected tenant, 3) open rollback PR if deploy suspected, 4) notify account team.

sid_eng: I'll open the PR with routing + hedging policy + telemetry hooks today (ETA 48h). Will include per-tenant dashboards and exported diffs.

claire_ml: I'll publish the 160-prompt eval set and run the preflight shadow; will post hourly snapshots. Key: include adversarial prompts for hallucinations and multi-turn roleplay cases.

deploy-bot: scheduled: preflight-shadow start=2024-11-12T03:00:00Z id=preflight-6800001234

emily_pm: Owners: sid (eng), raj (ops), claire (quality), mario (oncall). Action items: sid PR w/ hedging routing, raj reserve pool + ops ticket, claire publish eval set, mario add paging/runbook. We'll reconvene after preflight results. :thumbsup:
